leagues.name: Afghanistan Champions League
leagues.note: The Afghanistan Champions League has operated as the de facto top-tier men's competition since the original Afghan Premier League (franchise format) lapsed around 2016. Clubs listed are the 11 (of 12 licensed) that fielded teams in the 2024-25 edition, per Wikipedia; one licensed club (Khadim) withdrew mid-season. A 2025-26 edition and/or a relaunched five-team Afghan Premier League for 2026 were referenced in search snippets, but their club compositions could not be verified this session.
